paper.abstract_en: Entanglement islands are most easily realized in doubly holographic models with massive gravitons or non-gravitating baths. In wedge holography, however, Neumann boundary conditions on both branes give a normalizable massless graviton, while the island saddle of the purely geometric Ryu--Takayanagi (RT) problem collapses to the horizon. Negative Dvali--Gabadadze--Porrati (DGP) terms can restore nontrivial islands by modifying the endpoint condition, but this branch contains a massive ghost. We propose a different semiclassical mechanism. We keep the wedge gravitational action free of DGP terms and couple the healthy Neumann wedge sector to a unitary defect CFT localized at the codimension-two corner. This sector is distinct from the standard corner CFT dual to the undeformed wedge, so its entropy enters as the ordinary matter-entropy term in the quantum extremal surface (QES) prescription without double counting the wedge RT area. If the defect theory is holographic, this entropy can be evaluated by an auxiliary RT surface. We show that when the wedge endpoint determines the defect entangling region, the auxiliary area can vary in the opposite way to the wedge area while all couplings and central charges remain positive. A local endpoint model gives an isolated stable saddle that dominates over the Hartman--Maldacena (HM) surface at late times. The QES condition then replaces the pure orthogonality condition and permits a non-horizon island saddle in a long-range, massless, ghost-free gravitational theory. Thus, the obstruction to massless islands in minimal wedge holography is not masslessness itself, but the absence of a healthy matter-entropy contribution capable of balancing the horizon-minimizing area variation.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 提出一种新的半经典机制，在楔形全息中通过Defect CFT的熵贡献恢复非视界岛鞍点，避免了鬼场问题，具有理论深度和新颖性。
decision.title_zh: 楔形全息中的无质量岛
decision.abstract_zh: 纠缠岛最容易在具有有质量引力子或非引力浴的双重全息模型中实现。然而，在楔形全息中，两个膜上的诺伊曼边界条件给出一个可归一化的无质量引力子，而纯几何Ryu-Takayanagi (RT) 问题的岛鞍点塌缩到视界。负Dvali-Gabadadze-Porrati (DGP) 项可以通过修改端点条件恢复非平凡的岛，但该分支包含一个有质量鬼场。我们提出一种不同的半经典机制。我们保持楔形引力作用量不含DGP项，并将健康的诺伊曼楔形扇区与位于余维二角落的幺正缺陷CFT耦合。该扇区不同于标准角落CFT（其对偶于未变形楔形），因此其熵作为量子极值面(QES)方案中的普通物质熵项进入，而不重复计算楔形RT面积。如果缺陷理论是全息的，该熵可以通过一个辅助RT面积来评估。我们证明，当楔形端点决定缺陷纠缠区域时，辅助面积可以与楔形面积以相反方式变化，同时所有耦合和中心电荷保持为正。一个局部端点模型给出一个孤立的稳定鞍点，在晚期主导Hartman-Maldacena (HM) 面。然后QES条件取代纯正交条件，并允许在长程、无质量、无鬼场的引力理论中出现非视界岛鞍点。因此，最小楔形全息中无质量岛的障碍并非无质量本身，而是缺乏健康的物质熵贡献来平衡使面积最小化的视界变化。
